mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, we have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 49 degrees. As we look toward the morning, the overnight low will drop to 44 degrees with no rain in the forecast, and we are currently seeing a third quarter moon.

In city news, Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month to celebrate the contributions of our local planners. Additionally, the City of Verona Water Utility is beginning cross connection control surveys, so please keep an eye out for a letter in your mail to help keep our water safe.

Looking at the calendar, you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Later this week, there is plenty to do, including trivia at Hop Haus on Thursday and the ART House 360 events also beginning this Thursday.
On September 21, police were dispatched for a two-vehicle crash where a 59-year-old man was cited for operating too fast for the roadway conditions.

The Culver's flavor of the day today was Andes Mint Avalanche. Since the restaurant is now closed for the night, we invite you to stop by tomorrow when doors open at 10 AM to try the Chocolate Caramel Twist.
